title.zh-TW: 好友可得抵用金或首購折扣
title.en: Friend reward: credit or first-purchase discount

text.zh-TW: 依官方推薦計畫條款，獎勵可能是固定金額抵用金（舉例 $20）或首購折扣（推薦計畫頁寫 5%）；實際是哪一種，以註冊與結帳頁為準。
text.en: Per the referral terms, a fixed credit (e.g. $20) or a first-purchase discount (5% on the program page); checkout shows which applies.

title.zh-TW: 首年免費網域
title.en: Free domain for the first year

text.zh-TW: 方案比較頁列出 Starter、Pro、Max 含首年免費網域；適用的網域後綴與續約價格官方未載明，請在結帳頁確認。
text.en: The plan comparison page lists it for Starter, Pro and Max; eligible endings and renewal prices are not stated, so check at checkout.

title.zh-TW: 免費代為搬站
title.en: Free managed migration

text.zh-TW: 共享等方案含免費搬站；來源主機須提供 cPanel 帳號資料，從非 cPanel 的主機搬來可能另收費用（官方退款與計費政策）。
text.en: Included in the plans; you must provide cPanel details, and a move from a non-cPanel host may cost extra (official refund and billing policy).

title.zh-TW: 30 天退款保證
title.en: 30-day money-back guarantee

text.zh-TW: 共享主機標示 30 天；限首期、每位客戶只能使用一次，網域註冊費、設定費與搬站費不退款。
text.en: Listed for shared hosting; first term only and once per customer, and domain, setup and migration fees are not refunded.

title.en: 24/7/365 support

text.zh-TW: 官方標示以即時聊天、電話與工單全年無休服務，另有 AI 助理 Orbi；可用語言官方未載明，建議用英文提問。
text.en: Live chat, phone and tickets at all hours, plus the Orbi AI assistant; supported languages are not stated, so English is the safe choice.

title.zh-TW: 多地資料中心
title.en: Several data center locations

text.zh-TW: 共享與雲端方案列有美國、新加坡、倫敦、雪梨、孟買、法蘭克福；台灣訪客通常優先考慮新加坡。
text.en: Shared and cloud plans list the USA, Singapore, London, Sydney, Mumbai and Frankfurt; Singapore is usually the nearest for Taiwan.

title.zh-TW: 推薦人可獲得佣金
title.en: The referrer earns a commission

text.zh-TW: 推薦人可就新客戶的首次合格購買獲得佣金，審核期 45 天；金額與條件以 Hosting.com 官方公告為準。
text.en: Referrers earn a commission on a new customer's first eligible purchase, held 45 days for review; amounts follow Hosting.com's announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會在新分頁開啟）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it opens in a new tab).

steps.zh-TW: 比較共享主機的 Starter、Pro、Max 方案，依網站數量與儲存空間選一個；資料中心可先考慮新加坡。
steps.en: Compare the Starter, Pro and Max shared plans and pick one by number of sites and storage; Singapore is a sensible first data center to consider.

steps.zh-TW: 在結帳頁確認折扣或抵用金、首年免費網域與免費搬站是否已套用，再付款。
steps.en: At checkout, confirm that the discount or credit, the free first-year domain and the free migration are applied before you pay.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊後登入 Hosting Panel，可一鍵安裝 WordPress，或申請免費搬站。
steps.en: After signing up, log in to the Hosting Panel to install WordPress in one click or to request the free migration.

steps.zh-TW: 朋友獎勵若是抵用金，要等購買後 45 天審核期結束才會入帳，期間需保持有效客戶。
steps.en: If the friend reward is an account credit, it arrives only after the 45-day review period, and you must stay an active customer until then.

intro.zh-TW: Hosting.com 虛擬主機推薦連結：官方列有首年免費網域、免費搬站與 24/7/365 客服，好友透過連結註冊可能獲得朋友獎勵。
intro.en: Hosting.com web hosting referral link: the official site lists a free first-year domain, free migration and 24/7/365 support; friends may get a reward.

steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (a share page on the official lang.live domain; there is no code, as the referrer is already in the address).

steps.en: Register or log in to 浪LIVE as the app directs; it is rated 18+ on the App Store and the terms have legal-capacity rules, so check that it suits you first.

steps.zh-TW: 沒有邀請碼可輸入；若開啟連結後沒有看到邀請人名稱「浪客_7206394」，請回到本頁重新開啟連結。
steps.en: There is no code to type in. If the referrer name “浪客_7206394” is not shown after opening the link, reopen it from this page.

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請人專屬連結開啟浪LIVE，這是歌唱直播 App；連結沒有另外的邀請碼，直接開啟即可。
intro.en: Open 浪LIVE, a singing live-streaming app, via the referrer's personal link; no invite code.

steps.en: Select “Sign up”: code 10680329250 is copied, then the BIGO LIVE share link opens (on 2026-10-24 it redirected to bigo.tv; the code is not in the address).

steps.en: Download and open BIGO LIVE as the website or app store page directs; it is an 18+ app, so check that you qualify before registering.

steps.en: Per the share text, new users enter invite code 10680329250 (paste or type it); no official page on where it goes was found, so follow the app's screens.

intro.zh-TW: BIGO LIVE 是須年滿 18 歲的直播與聊天 App；依分享文案，新用戶填寫邀請碼 10680329250。
intro.en: BIGO LIVE is an 18+ live-streaming and chat app; per its share text, new users enter invite code 10680329250.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結。分享文案沒有邀請碼，連結會轉到 WePlay 官方網域上的 PK 邀請頁。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link. The share text has no code, and the link leads to a PK invitation page on WePlay's official domain.

steps.en: Follow the page to download WePlay, then register or log in; download only from the App Store, Google Play or the listings linked from weplayapp.com.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊時需要填寫生日。平台以 13 歲為最低年齡，未滿 18 歲須經家長或法定監護人同意，台灣 App Store 分級為 16+，請先確認自己符合條件。
steps.en: Registration asks for your birthday. Minimum age 13 (higher where local law requires); under-18s need a parent's or guardian's consent; App Store rating 16+.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊時是否帶入邀請人沒有測試過；若沒有，請回到本頁重新開啟連結，實際規則以 WePlay 官方說明為準。
steps.en: Whether the referrer is applied at sign-up was not tested; if not, reopen the link from this page.

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請人的 PK 邀請連結開啟 WePlay，一款可語音聊天的派對遊戲 App；沒有列出邀請碼與獎勵。
intro.en: Open WePlay, a party-game app with voice chat, via the referrer's PK invite link. No code or reward listed.

steps.en: On your phone, select “Sign up” to open the link (a desktop browser only asks you to switch to a phone).

steps.zh-TW: 依指示下載 Lalamove 司機版 App，只從官方上架頁安裝，並用本人手機註冊。
steps.en: Download the Lalamove driver app as directed, install it only from the official store listing, and register on your own phone.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊頁請使用推薦碼 2VPF5B（已在連結中；手動輸入請依原樣含大小寫）。依分享文案，未使用推薦碼註冊，推薦視為無效。
steps.en: Use code 2VPF5B on the registration page (already in the link; if typed, enter it exactly as shown). Per the share text, a referral without it is invalid.

steps.zh-TW: 依 App 指示完成註冊並等待審核；通過審核才算加入。
steps.en: Follow the app to finish registration and wait for review; you join only after approval.
